status: frozen local diagnostic harness v1; no final renderer, CPU or reference qualification
fixture: tests/m2/trace-client.ts; actual installed private tarball via /pkg/dist, no workspace runtime alias
collector: Chromium CDP Tracing ReturnAsStream, 64 MiB continuous buffer, reject dataLossOccurred; exact gzip6 raw JSON and hashes retained

protocol.order: static-first on even valid pair indices, animated-first on odd; warmups separate
protocol.fresh: new browser context/page/instances for every presentation; prepare paused before fresh eligibility
invalidOnly: missing or ambiguous phase marks / truncated trace
trace stream loss or missing main-thread task coverage

phases.initialization: after warm code import/registration; mark before constructing hosts, end after two RAFs; sum traced work, elapsed separate
phases.setup: resume or ready patch through coalesced microtask commit; separate from complete visual duration
phases.active: fixed fresh idle/handoff window, clipped by start timestamp and declared duration; later static tail excluded even if finish timer is delayed
phases.coldImport: unverified; new contexts are not proof of cold browser code caches

partition: renderer main thread is pinned by unique active:start mark pid/tid; nested X/B/E intervals assigned once to innermost classified owner; RunTask fills unclassified other overhead; preserve raw event names and all categories
clock: trace event wall-time main-thread work proxy; includes descheduling/preemption, not hardware thread CPU; CPU qualification remains unverified
pairing: relative frame bins from pre-run median of 120 delivered RAF intervals, fixed for entire run; additional=max(0,animated-static) per bin, signed differences retained for render and all busy time; no subtraction of sorted percentiles
cadence: per visible surface successful changed-command commit timestamps plus delivered harness RAF intervals; instrumentation included, not physical presentation proof; headless scheduling estimate does not verify display cadence

statistics.requiredBothPasses: 18 of 20 plus pooled p95 and p99

longTasks: retain all >=50ms main-thread tasks intersecting init through teardown; record nested package script URLs and both static/animated traces; any animated long task is unresolved-or-fail pending attribution, never green from percentiles alone
geometry: same deterministic 360-dot 30x12 field and eight-point line/eight bars/ten scatter points, numeric 42.50 (own 5x7 glyphs), six rows/three columns as prior proof; scaled from 320x160 content coordinates

list.scrollPath: stationary at 0; scrolling canonical fixture remains unverified

ownership: idle profiles are standalone skeletons; handoff profiles each add one region and actual chart/text/table content (normal handoff has 48 public hosts, not canonical 30)

environment.styles: inline-authorized native styles; external fixture CSS; strict no style attributes
environment.font: system-ui, table monospace; no network fonts
environment.thermalAndPower: uncontrolled local diagnostic; recorded as such
environment.browser: bundled headless Chromium, exact version and launch/runtime/OS data recorded per run

claims: collection success is not budget qualification. Missing physical hardware, actual per-bin CPU, optical cadence, canonical full catalog, scrolling list, cold import, SSR/hydration, input latency, full heap/AT and human equal-quality review remain unverified. Renderer choices stay provisional.
smoke: one paired presentation, zero warmups; never completes the 3/20 protocol or replaces a complete baseline
threadCpu: Use outermost task tdur where present; fully enclosed tasks are exact, clipped phase/frame tasks get lower/upper bounds from total CPU and wall overlap, never uniform interpolation. Missing tdur is explicit unknown with wall upper bound. Preserve per-bin signed CPU intervals; do not present bounds as exact per-bin CPU.
